strategy.thesis: Israel's leading crypto fund (since 2018), making high-conviction, strictly non-consensus early-stage investments (pre-seed to Series A) across DeFi, infrastructure, privacy, stablecoins and Bitcoin layers. 'The internet freed information. Crypto is freeing money.'

summary.en: Collider is Israel's leading and first dedicated crypto/Web3 venture fund, founded in Tel Aviv in 2018. It manages over $200M and makes high-conviction, non-consensus early-stage (pre-seed to Series A) investments across DeFi, infrastructure, privacy and Bitcoin layers. Portfolio includes Safe, The Graph, Ether.fi, Fhenix and CoW Protocol. Led by founding partners Adam Benayoun, Avishay Ovadia and Ofer Rotem.

summary.en: Lionschain Capital is a Jerusalem-based, thesis-driven long/short cryptocurrency fund founded in 2017 by Zachary Wolfson, investing in and trading liquid digital assets while making selective early-stage venture investments in crypto projects (e.g. Beam, StakeWise, Keyp). It reported a 109% net return since inception (March 2018).

strategy.thesis: The first fully tokenized VC fund, investing in blockchain ecosystem-building and tokenization (RWA / digital securities) companies, providing liquidity to LPs via tradable security tokens.

summary.en: SPiCE VC is the first fully tokenized venture capital fund, founded in 2017 by Israeli entrepreneur Tal Elyashiv (co-founded with Carlos Domingo, who went on to found Securitize). It invests in blockchain ecosystem and tokenization (RWA / digital securities) companies and is operated across Singapore, the US and Israel. SPiCE I closed in 2018 (raising $15M in a 2018 STO toward a $100M target) and SPiCE II closed in 2023; the fund reports over 2.1x DPI.

strategy.thesis: Israel's first dedicated blockchain/Web3 incubation program, launched by the Mamram Alumni Association (IDF central computing unit veterans) to support founders from the ideation/exploration stage and position Israel as a global blockchain powerhouse.

perks: Mentorship from StarkWare, Fireblocks and Collider VC
program.eligibility: Early-stage blockchain/Web3 projects at the exploration and ideation stages, typically yet to build an MVP or proof-of-concept.

application.how_to_apply: Via the Mamram Alumni Association blockchain incubator program

summary.en: The Mamram Blockchain Incubator (M.B.I), launched in 2024 by the Mamram Alumni Association (8,000+ IDF central computing unit veterans), is Israel's first dedicated blockchain/Web3 incubation program. It supports founders from the ideation stage with mentorship and technology partnerships from StarkWare, Fireblocks and Collider VC, plus legal support from Gornitzky & Co. Investment amount, equity and cohort details are not publicly disclosed.
